title: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)
statement_short: Design a data structure that supports inserting a value, removing a value, and obtaining a random element, all in average O(1) time. Each element must have an equal probability of being returned by the random operation.
constraints: -2^31 <= val <= 2^31 - 1, at most 2 \* 10^5 calls will be made to insert, remove, and getRandom
hint: The O(1) average time requirement for search combined with uniform random selection mandates combining a hash map with a dynamic array.
why_not: Right: HashMap / Hash Set maps values to array indices, enabling O(1) deletion via swap-with-last element and O(1) random array access. Not Heap / Priority Queue: Deleting an arbitrary value or getting a random element from a heap takes O(n) time. Not Binary Search: Binary search requires a sorted structure, making O(1) arbitrary insertion and random sampling impossible. Not Two Pointers: Two pointers require linear scanning for value lookups and deletions.
